subject: Consolidated partner pilot: selection recommendations + SOW next steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated partner pilot: shortlist + SOW draft attached

Team —

Thanks for the quick reviews this morning. Per our procurement checklist I pulled together a recommended pilot approach to consolidate PR, design, and event production for Q1 trade shows and the Feb product launch. Goal is to run a 3-month pilot with one lead partner responsible for PR + creative and a co-sourced event production partner to reduce coordination overhead and reduce agency fees.

Attached: partner_pilot_scope_v1.docx (scope + evaluation criteria).

High-level recs:
- Lead creative & PR: Brightline PR (strong product narrative and press relationships)
- Event production: Stellar Events (best logistical coverage in SF + flexible ODC model)
- Design contractor (retainer): DesignHaus for on-call creative tasks, 60 hours/month cap

Budget expectation: ~$120k over 3 months across agencies (estimated; line items in the doc). Procurement will need approved SOWs and standard T&Cs; I asked procurement to pre-clear insurance and data handling language.

Next steps: Laura, can you confirm commercial appetite to pilot vs rebid? Tessa, please prioritize quick reference calls with the Brightline lead (Kate) and ops at Stellar. If both checks are green we route SOW to Legal for standard redlines and then to Finance for PO.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: partner_pilot_scope_v1.docx (docx)]

Hi Grace —

Really excited about the proposed pilot. Thanks for sending the scope. A couple quick notes from our side after the internal kickoff:
- We can cover lead PR + strategic creative (messaging, 2 press memos, 4 targeted media outreaches) within the proposed budget if DesignHaus is handling visual assets.
- For event activation we recommend a half-day press breakfast and a demo area; we can coordinate media invites but would rely on Stellar for floor plan and vendor management.
- Standard timeline: 2-week planning, 4 weeks execution, ongoing measurement.

Attached is our SOW template with commercial terms (SOW_Brightline_PR_202612.pdf). We can strip any non-starters in Legal.

Kate Hammond

Hi Tessa / Laura —

Appreciate the invite to bid. Quick operational notes after reviewing the scope:
- We can provide full production for the SF demo day and the trade show booth in March. Early estimate: $55k-$72k depending on AV spec and demo hardware load.
- We included a preliminary floorplan (event_floorplan_v2.png) to show booth flow and demo staging.
- We can operate as prime or sub to Brightline; we prefer to be contracted directly by Redwood for clarity on insurance.

Questions:
1) Do you want us to include storage and on-site tech crew in the baseline?
2) Is there a preferred lead time for freight and customs? (we typically recommend 3 weeks for domestic specialized shipping)

If helpful, we can do a 20-minute sync this week to walk the floorplan.

— Stellar Events Ops

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Consolidated partner pilot: shortlist + SOW draft attached

Thanks all — quick procurement and finance notes from my side:

1) Commercial: The $120k estimate is acceptable as a pilot spend, but we need a line-item breakout and fixed-price caps for major deliverables (press outreach, event production, design retainer) to avoid scope creep. Please ask vendors to return revised cost tables by EOD Monday.

2) Legal / Terms: procurement pre-cleared insurance minimums and IP language. We still need to confirm data handling for press lists (PII) — recommend adding a Data Processing Addendum clause or explicit handling notes in the SOW.

3) PO process: Once SOWs are signed we will issue a single PO per vendor. Finance asks for a 30-day net payment term; if they request 45/60 please flag for approval.

Laura Bennett
Director, Procurement
Redwood Inference
